page.layout: One page of text, single column: running head "(PAG. 4.)" at top centre; ornamental headband; title block; table of contents with chapter numbers at left, titles and page numbers at right; catchword "fratres" at lower right.

main_text.head: QVÆ DVOBVS LIBRIS HUIUS IRENICI CONTINEATVR, POST EPISTOLAS & APORIAS.
main_text.p: Liber primus exhibet pacificam ad Aporias responsionem, interspersis etiam aliis.
main_text.l: CAP. I. AD quatuor primas Aporias: de Geniculatione in sacra Cœna. PAG. 13
II. Ad quintam Aporiam: de Mensa DOMINICA. 19
III. Ad sextam Aporiam: de communione inter populum: ubi de patina et distributione Panis. 21
IV. Ad septimam Aporiam: de exemplo CHRISTI et Apostolorum. 22
V. Incipit responsio ad octavam Aporiam: ubi de necessitate obedientiæ, et de æquitate decreti PERTHENSIS, ad quam demonstrandam adferuntur rationes ab intuitu Regis articulos proponentis. 28
VI. De jure et authoritate Synodi PERTHENSIS. 36
VII. Synodum rerum ipsarum intuitu recte judicasse: ubi de ipsis quinque Articulis sigillatim disseritur: et explicatur quæstio, An res sit abjicienda propter abusum. Et, de gestu mensali. 39
VIII. Iudicii Synodici rationes justæ ac idoneæ ex intuitu Ecclesiæ SCOTICANÆ: ubi resistentes convincuntur schismatis. 46
IX. De juramento à SCOTIS præstito, ANNO DOMINI 1581: ubi ostenditur resistentes Fratres

page.notes: The ornamental headband and the large decorated initial "A" are not transcribed. Chapter I's initial "A" is a woodcut letter joined to "D quatuor". Line breaks in the table are reproduced as lines; the ending "Fratres" is the catchword.
